title: Normalized derived unit for an exact compactification sheaf functor
statement:
Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→Y a morphism of schemes, c=(j,p) a compactification, F an additive exact functor on constant-A module sheaves, and a:F≅j!⋙p*. Define δ(c,F,a):D(F)→Dj!⋙Rp* by descending the termwise transformation D(F)→Q(p*j!)→Rp*Dj!. The transformation on homotopy representatives is the map induced by a followed by the total-right-derived unit of p*, with the canonical exact-functor localization factorizations.
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison].

proof.text: Apply the exact-functor factorization for F, apply a on homotopy complexes, and separate j! followed by p* with mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso. Apply the proper direct-image derived unit, then the inverse localization factorization of the exact open extension. Descend this natural transformation with normalizationLocalizationDesc. Full faithfulness specifies its unique descent; no existence witness for an unspecified object is chosen.
